notes.title: Hopping Up for It: All Hops walkthrough
notes.notes:
Need any help hopping your way through Hopping Up for It?  It's a long way down, so here's a quick video which shows every hop (with any falls edited out) to help you make it up!
[previewyoutube=zVvVGXgExKw;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]
Remember that unless you're on a no-saves run, you can of course save any time, and you can use right-click (minimum-sized hops) to inch your way back up while slipping off a steep edge.

Happy hopping!
